bottom_fade.reason: Dissolve the bust's lower (chest/waist) edge so it does not end on a hard horizontal clipped line.

side_vignette.reason: Face close-up only: the tight head-anchored crop cuts the bracing arm (left) and streaming hair (right) as hard vertical edges inside the cell.
